about_the_game:
The Final Version Name <Cultivation Magic World> is Coming Soon

Hello everyone, we would like to express our sincere gratitude for your support—without it, Cultivation World would not have come into existence, and we want to give a special thanks to the players who supported us in the early stages!

The <Cultivation Magic World> series has previously released <XiuzhenWorld> 、<XiuzhenWorld2> 、<Cultivation Magic World>, with each subsequent work being an upgrade of the previous one. Due to the developer's lack of game release experience initially, this release rhythm was formed, and the upcoming <Cultivation Magic World> is a more polished version.

<Cultivation Magic World> is planned to launch its Early Access version on January 1, 2026. We will continue to update it for at least one year afterward, and finally release the official version. We will do our best to bring a great experience to players.

Version Synchronization Instructions

After the Early Access version of <Cultivation Magic World> is released, once the version is stable (tentatively scheduled for February 1, 2026), the latest version will be synchronized to <XiuzhenWorld> 、<XiuzhenWorld2>.

For players who are eager to experience the game, you can purchase the bundle of the three games to get <Cultivation Magic World> at a lower price. However, we still recommend that you wait a little while.

For players who have already purchased <XiuzhenWorld> 、<XiuzhenWorld2>, the content of the two games will be completely consistent after the update. If you need to run two instances simultaneously, you can launch both games at the same time.

How to Switch to the Old Version

  • Open the Steam client, find the corresponding game in your library, right-click on it and select "Properties";

  • Click "Betas" in the left menu, and enter the test password "123456789666";

  • Restart the Steam client, and you will be able to switch to the old version of the game.

XiuzhenWorld

《XiuzhenWorld》 is a 3D world where your goal is to level up from a mere mortal into an immortal at the end.

Its a semi-idle game with fun immortal cultivation mechanics such as

- leveling up to become stronger.

- capturing monsters as pets to fight for you.

- killing monsters & comparing the stats of different equipment loot you get.

- over 10 different combat skills which get unlocked as you level up to kill monsters even faster.

- upgrading your weapons to become more powerful with currency you collect from monsters.

- opening treasure chests which drop from monsters, these treasure chests provide random drops, see how lucky you are.

- Reincarnation to come back stronger with better base stats.

- The game comes with a built-in AFK(Away From Keybourd) function.

Please note there is no storyline for this game, the core gameplay is mainly about killing monsters in the endless battleground and praying you get better equipment drops from these monsters.Its meant to be played as an idler game, with a few minutes required every few hours to check equipment drops your character got while you are working. Try this immortal cultivation idler game which has auto hack and slash combat.

legal_notice:
Disclaimers
The purpose of the game gift function is to promote communication between players
Everyone makes private transactions and beware of being deceived
Cheating behaviors such as copying equipment, modifying game data, and copying saves will prohibit the use of the gift function
During the game operation, it is prohibited to open auxiliary tools such as Cheet Engine and Kingsoft Ranger, otherwise the use of the gift function is prohibited
In addition, the game cannot completely avoid players using modifiers and evade game detection. You may receive items that have been modified by other players (this behavior will not trigger a ban)
